_comment: Path combos (Docs/plan/DATA_SCHEMAS.md 'Combo', cooks/biome-lightning.md 2.18.4): a main path and subclass pair with at least at25 / at50 points spent in BOTH paths owns that level's combo. grants: the gameplay tags the owner gets (the combat code reads them). requires: 'path.node' the owner must have learned too (CB rule: Meltdown needs Overheat, Blizzard storm needs Blizzard). numbers: the combo's own first-draft numbers (FWRComboRegistry::Num). Loaded by WRCombos.cpp; the pairs with no grants yet are display-only.

at25.name: Thaw
at25.text: Burning a frozen enemy deals a big burst of damage

at50.name: Balance
at50.text: Heat and Chill fill each other as you use them

at25.name: Plasma
at25.text: Fire on shocked enemies arcs as burning lightning

at50.name: Meltdown
at50.text: Overheat explosions chain lightning to every enemy they hit

at25.name: Brittle shock
at25.text: Shocks on frozen enemies shatter them

at50.name: Burning lifesteal
at50.text: Burn damage heals you for a small share of it

at50.name: Red lightning
at50.text: Chain lightning causes bleed on every target

at25.name: Black flame
at25.text: Your burns bite through armour: +10% burn damage on armoured foes

at50.name: Void furnace
at50.text: Void you gain also builds Heat; at full Heat void abilities cost half the max HP

at50.name: Singularity spark
at50.text: Black hole crackles: a 20-damage bolt to a foe inside every 0.5 s

at25.name: Frozen blink
at25.text: Blinking freezes the spot you left: a 2.5 m frost patch for 4 s

at50.name: Ice maw
at50.text: Consume works on any frozen foe that isn't a boss, at any health

at25.name: Void leech
at25.text: 30% of your lifesteal healing wins back max HP first

at50.name: Abyssal hunger
at50.text: Consume also heals a quarter of your max HP
